# Apples with bruises and good flavour

The smallest tree has ugly fruit with excellent flavour. The catalogue photographs made me treat appearance as a proxy for success. We will cook the bruised apples this weekend rather than argue about whether the tree should be replaced. [[Garden notebook]]: choosing a use can change whether the same result counts as waste.
